title: ZLINE — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for ZLINE.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Professional Kitchen, Attainable Price." ZLINE Kitchen & Bath disrupted the appliance market by offering pro-style ranges and range hoods at prices 50-70% below traditional brands. Founded in 2009, they started online-only and built a cult following. Now in major retailers. The quality has improved significantly in recent years, though service networks are still developing.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Budget-conscious buyers who want the pro-style look. First-time range hood buyers. Online shoppers comfortable with newer brands.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for ZLINE:

• Pro-style 48-inch range for under $3,000 — impossible from traditional brands

• Massive range hood selection — more styles and sizes than anyone

• Direct-to-consumer roots keep prices dramatically lower

• Growing retail presence validates the brand

• Rapidly improving quality with each product generation
